gst.notes: GST remains 10% on most taxable supplies per current ATO guidance; confirm concessions or input-taxed treatments before lodging.

medicare.notes: Singles pay no levy below $27,222 (SAPTO $43,020). Families pay no levy below $45,907 (SAPTO $59,886) with an extra $4,216 per dependent child; thresholds taper in at 10% until the full 2% levy applies.

offsets.name: Low Income Tax Offset (LITO)
offsets.description: Up to $700 for incomes up to $37,500 in 2024-25, reducing progressively to nil at $66,667.

offsets.name: Low and Middle Income Tax Offset (LMITO)
offsets.description: Currently legislated as nil for 2024-25 and later. Retained for historical comparisons.

offsets.name: Senior Australians and Pensioners Tax Offset
offsets.description: Available subject to eligibility tests and income limits that vary by status. Refer to a tax agent for personalised assessment.

baseRateEntity.criteria: Aggregated turnover below $50 million and no more than 80% passive income.

failureToLodge.description: Failure to Lodge penalties accrue at one $330 penalty unit per 28 days (small entities, capped at 5 units). Medium entities pay double and large entities pay five times the base amount; remission depends on compliance history.

generalInterestCharge.description: General Interest Charge (GIC) accrues daily on outstanding tax debts and is no longer deductible for amounts incurred on or after 1 July 2025.

instantAssetWriteOff.eligibility: Aggregated turnover under $10 million and assets first used or installed ready for use within the eligible window.
instantAssetWriteOff.notes: Assets costing more than the threshold must be placed into the small business pool.

simplifiedDepreciation.eligibility: Available to small businesses using the simplified depreciation rules with aggregated turnover under $10 million.
simplifiedDepreciation.notes: When the closing pool balance falls below the instant asset write-off threshold it can be written off in full.

smallBusiness.reminder: Temporary $20,000 instant asset write-off ends 30 June 2025 unless extended by Parliament.

generalInterestCharge.description: General Interest Charge is applied using daily compounding interest. Rates change each quarter based on the 90-day bank bill rate plus a 7 percentage point uplift.

benchmarkInterest.description: Division 7A benchmark interest rate applies to shareholder or associate loans to avoid deemed dividends.
benchmarkInterest.frankingNotes: Use the benchmark rate to set minimum yearly repayments on complying Division 7A loans.
